$comment: Machine-readable sidecar for the Salesmessage brand; mirrors StyleGuide.txt. Colors are the Figma design-system values (examples/figma-sms-credit-guide), except cta, which Figma does not define.
name: Salesmessage
voice: Clear, confident and friendly; written for busy sales and support teams.
Lead with the customer outcome, then the feature that delivers it.
Short sentences, active voice, no jargon; numbers beat adjectives.
rules: Headlines use Inter Bold in ink #171c28; body copy uses Inter Regular in muted #525d6e.
Salesmsg Blue #24a5df is the accent; reserve Green #13cb6e for a single call-to-action button.
Light-blue gradient hero bands, soft #eaf6fd panels and generous white space, as in the Figma customer guide.
